## Change / 修改内容

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. / 说明具体问题及修改后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List relevant host tests and separate physical-device results. / 列出相关桌面测试，单独说明真机结果。

## Documentation and language / 文档和语言

Update both English and Simplified Chinese UI/documentation for user-facing changes. Keep API keys and user data unchanged. / 用户可见修改同步更新中英文界面和文档，保留协议字段及用户数据。

Do not include credentials, tokens, personal media or device dumps. / 不包含密码、Token、私人素材或设备转储。
